book.title: The Immortals Boxed Set (The Immortals, #1-3)
book.description:
True love never dies in Alyson Noel's extraordinary paranormal series featuring Immortal teens. The books follow Ever Bloom and Damen Auguste’s epic romance as they travel through eternity to be together forever. These two soul mates are thwarted at every turn by jealous rivals, evil ex-girlfriends, enemies at school and even their own weaknesses. But through it all, they never lose sight of their ultimate goal—to spend eternity together.  But will fate ever give them the chance?
 
This Immortals boxed set includes the novels Evermore, Blue Moon and Shadowland.
